audience: clinic prescribers and staff who set up e-prescribing with Photon Health

useCases.title: Find pharmacies by name or near a location
useCases.text: The AI searches pharmacies by name, or near a latitude and longitude within a radius in miles, for pick-up or mail order. It returns NPI, NCPDP, address, phone and fax.

useCases.title: Look up a medication, its products and package codes
useCases.text: The AI searches the medication database by drug name or by RxCUI, NDC or SKU. It then lists the strengths and forms, the packages and the NDC codes.

useCases.title: Review your treatment catalogs and prescription templates
useCases.text: The AI lists the organization's catalogs and reads one with its treatments and templates: quantity, refills, days supply and directions.

useCases.title: Review users, organization, equipment and dispense units
useCases.text: The AI reads the organization details and lists its users with name, NPI, credentials and roles. It can also search prescribable equipment and list dispense units.
